name: ATTOM Data API
tagline: National property records, valuations, sales history, and neighborhood analytics via REST.
description: ATTOM Data Solutions provides a comprehensive real estate data API covering property characteristics, ownership, valuations, sales and mortgage history, tax assessments, and neighborhood/market analytics for the United States. Developers query by address, APN, or geocoordinates and receive structured property intelligence used in proptech, lending, insurance, and investment applications. Access is typically API-key authenticated against ATTOM’s gateway with tiered commercial plans.

auth.details: API key via apikey header (or query param in some examples); self-serve developer portal signup required.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Trial/evaluation access available via developer portal; concrete free request quotas not fully published without account — verify current plan details on signup.
pricing.paid_plans: Commercial subscription packages by data product and volume; contact sales for production pricing.

use_cases: look up property characteristics and ownership by street address
get estimated property value / AVM for a parcel
retrieve sales and mortgage history for a property
fetch tax assessment and building details by APN or coordinates
pull neighborhood or market analytics for an area
enrich a lead or loan application with property record data
